hypotheses.title: Hypothesis A: Authorized Maintenance & Storage Migration Incident
hypotheses.summary: The disappearance of quantum_protocol_v3.pdf was the benign byproduct of an authorized, scheduled maintenance operation executed by Systems Administrator Marcus Vance and the DevSecOps automated daemon, compounded by disk hardware degradation and an unsynchronized server clock.
missing_information: Complete rsync transfer exit log from nightly_sync.sh on SVR-VAULT-01.
Full uncompressed sector dump of failing drive /dev/sdb.
assumptions: The cron job nightly_sync.sh deleted or moved the source file upon completion due to --remove-source-files flag.
The apparent post-exit activity at 01:47:15 UTC is entirely explained by NTP clock skew (+3200ms) and buffered logging.
unanswered_questions: Why did the backup replica on NAS-STORAGE-09 have a corrupted/different SHA-256 digest?
Why was chmod 777 executed globally instead of granting access specifically to the backup service account?
suggested_next_steps: Inspect NAS-STORAGE-09 filesystem journals to determine if block corruption occurred in transit.
Review Marcus Vance's terminal shell history to confirm whether --remove-source-files was set in nightly_sync.sh.

hypotheses.title: Hypothesis B: Unrecognized Access Sequence & Exfiltration
hypotheses.summary: An unauthorized party leveraged the external VPN split tunnel from 198.51.100.42, authenticated via an uncataloged mTLS certificate (svc-daemon-guest), took advantage of elevated permissions (chmod 777), altered or exfiltrated the quantum protocol, and removed the active file.
missing_information: Secondary packet capture log EVD-099 from intermediate gateway switch.
CA issuance log for client certificate CN=svc-daemon-guest.
assumptions: The external connection from 198.51.100.42 was adversary-controlled rather than an employee working remotely.
The file mismatch indicates intentional tampering rather than storage sector corruption.
unanswered_questions: Did the 4.2GB bulk egress flow transfer to an unauthorized remote destination, or strictly to NAS-STORAGE-09?
Who provisioned and signed the mTLS client certificate CN=svc-daemon-guest?
suggested_next_steps: Perform cryptographic validation of client certificate CN=svc-daemon-guest against root CA.
Examine external gateway firewall state tables to check if outbound traffic reached the public internet.

contradiction_rules.rule_name: Incompatible Physical Egress vs Console Activity
contradiction_rules.rule_condition: Event timestamp(Console_Activity) > Event timestamp(Physical_Badge_Exit) FOR SAME ENTITY without intervening entrance
contradiction_rules.observed_values: Physical Exit at 01:45:00 UTC (EVD-009) vs Recorded Console Activity at 01:47:15 UTC (EVT-022)
contradiction_rules.triggering_reason: Console activity was attributed to Dr. Elena Rostova two minutes after her physical exit badge scan was recorded at the South lab turnstile.
alternative_explanations: SVR-VAULT-01 was suffering from +3200ms NTP clock drift and delayed syslog buffer flushing.
A background script or queued terminal pipe finished execution after Dr. Rostova physically departed.
An unauthorized party accessed the unlocked console after Dr. Rostova left.
contradiction_rules.missing_information: Real-time process accounting logs with monotonic kernel timestamps (CLOCK_MONOTONIC).
contradiction_rules.suggested_action: Apply hypothetical timeline adjustment with NTP skew offset (-3200ms) to verify if commands occurred prior to exit.
contradiction_rules.limitations: Timestamp correlation assumes both clock sources are stable. NTP slew rate during synchronization can introduce nonlinear drift.

contradiction_rules.triggering_reason: The recovered file quantum_protocol_v3_tampered.pdf from the backup snapshot does not match the official reference digest of quantum_protocol_v3.pdf.
alternative_explanations: Deliberate modification of the specification file by an unauthorized party.
Silent bit-rot or file header truncation during disk sector reallocation (/dev/sdb failure).
An incomplete rsync transfer interrupted before byte completion.
contradiction_rules.missing_information: Intermediate chunk-level block hashes from transfer stream.
contradiction_rules.suggested_action: Perform side-by-side hex diff inspection between original and recovered samples to isolate modified bytes.
contradiction_rules.limitations: A hash mismatch proves the file contents differ, but cannot determine whether the difference was caused by malicious tampering, file corruption, or incomplete transfer.

contradiction_rules.rule_name: Missing Source Evidence Reference in Event Sequence
contradiction_rules.rule_condition: Event refers to Evidence_ID that is absent from loaded Evidence Manifest
contradiction_rules.observed_values: Event EVT-008 references secondary switch packet capture 'EVD-099' which is unarchived
contradiction_rules.triggering_reason: Packet capture evidence from the secondary access switch was purged due to rolling buffer retention policy.
alternative_explanations: Normal rolling buffer retention overwrote older packet captures before preservation order arrived.
Logging level on the access switch was set to error only.
contradiction_rules.missing_information: Secondary switch raw PCAP packet stream for port Gi0/14.
contradiction_rules.suggested_action: Consult core firewall logs (EVD-001) as secondary corroborating network source.
contradiction_rules.limitations: Absence of a log does not imply intentional destruction.

contradiction_rules.rule_name: Unknown Entity Reference in TLS Authentication
contradiction_rules.observed_values: CN=svc-daemon-guest not found in Active Directory or service account catalog
contradiction_rules.triggering_reason: TLS client certificate was accepted by reverse proxy without LDAP account verification.
alternative_explanations: Legacy contractor service account left behind during third-party security audit.
Adversary generated self-signed certificate accepted due to misconfigured trust store.
contradiction_rules.suggested_action: Inspect Certificate Authority root trust store to locate issuing authority.
contradiction_rules.limitations: Entity uncataloged status may reflect poor documentation rather than compromise.

contradiction_rules.rule_condition: Inode_Deallocation_Timestamp < Snapshot_Registration_Timestamp WHILE file present in snapshot metadata
contradiction_rules.observed_values: Inode unlinked at 01:38:00 UTC while snapshot at 01:50:00 UTC still lists pointer
contradiction_rules.triggering_reason: Ext4 inode was unlinked 12 minutes prior to object storage snapshot generation, yet snapshot metadata retained entry.
alternative_explanations: Snapshot tool read from asynchronous storage cache rather than live disk blocks.
Delayed sync barrier on clustered filesystem.
contradiction_rules.suggested_action: Check mount options for async vs sync write mode on SVR-VAULT-01.
contradiction_rules.limitations: Filesystem caching artifacts frequently create temporal anomalies.

contradiction_rules.observed_values: EVD-012 recovered from ad-hoc snapshot without chain-of-custody cryptographic signature
contradiction_rules.triggering_reason: The file was collected during emergency response without formal forensic acquisition imaging.
alternative_explanations: Rapid response protocol prioritized speed over formal disk imaging.
contradiction_rules.missing_information: Forensic write-blocker verification log and acquisition hash log.
contradiction_rules.suggested_action: Re-acquire disk image of NAS-STORAGE-09 using write-blocking hardware.
contradiction_rules.limitations: Prototype demonstration data. Does not satisfy legal chain of custody.

contradiction_rules.rule_name: NTP Clock Discrepancy Affecting Sequence Analysis
contradiction_rules.triggering_reason: Significant clock skew invalidates naive millisecond ordering between server logs and external door badge logs.
alternative_explanations: Virtual machine time drift following hypervisor live migration.
NTP daemon network packet drop during lab power fluctuation (EVD-021).
contradiction_rules.suggested_action: Normalize server timestamps by subtracting 3200ms when reconstructing causal order.
contradiction_rules.limitations: Time correction is an analytical hypothesis and must never overwrite original raw logs.

missing_evidence_items.title: Secondary Switch Gi0/14 Full Packet Capture (EVD-099)
missing_evidence_items.why_it_matters: Without raw payload packets, the investigation cannot prove whether the 4.2GB transfer contained exfiltrated research files or routine compressed OS images.
missing_evidence_items.resolution_steps: Check secondary network tap storage appliances or gateway netflow export archives for retained session flows.

missing_evidence_items.title: Internal CA Certificate Revocation & Issuance Log
missing_evidence_items.why_it_matters: Determines whether CN=svc-daemon-guest was officially issued by lab management or forged.
missing_evidence_items.resolution_steps: Query Microsoft CA / Vault PKI audit log for certificate serial 0x7A8812B.

missing_evidence_items.title: Drive /dev/sdb Hardware Bad Block Inode Mapping
missing_evidence_items.why_it_matters: Confirms whether the 14 reallocated sectors physically coincided with inode #482910.
missing_evidence_items.resolution_steps: Run badblocks -v /dev/sdb and cross-reference with debugfs inode block table.

missing_evidence_items.title: Nightly Sync Shell Script Exact Execution Arguments
missing_evidence_items.why_it_matters: Proves whether rsync was instructed to delete source files with --remove-source-files flag.
missing_evidence_items.resolution_steps: Recover deleted /usr/local/bin/nightly_sync.sh from backup or inspect process accounting logs.

missing_evidence_items.title: USB Storage Device SanDisk File Transfer History
missing_evidence_items.why_it_matters: Determines whether any files were written to the mounted USB drive at /mnt/usb before sleep.
missing_evidence_items.resolution_steps: Obtain physical acquisition of SanDisk USB drive (Serial AA010928371) and inspect partition table.
